name: edrisaturay/filament-starter-minimal
description: Minimal Filament v5 starter plugin: essential panel plugins only (Shield-first, extensible registry).

suggest.kenepa/resource-lock: Prevent two users from editing the same record simultaneously (no Filament v5 release yet ; registry entry is class_exists-guarded).
suggest.filament/spatie-laravel-settings-plugin: Settings pages backed by spatie/laravel-settings (component package).
suggest.filament/spatie-laravel-tags-plugin: Filament form components for spatie/laravel-tags (component package).
suggest.riodwanto/filament-ace-editor: Ace code-editor form field for Filament (component package).
suggest.ralphjsmit/laravel-filament-components: Collection of handy Filament form/table components (component package).
suggest.owen-it/laravel-auditing: Eloquent auditing trait ; wire into your models, not registered as a Filament plugin.
